scope_definitions.BR_PATTERN: frozen breakout_retest returns a candidate at the decision close, before factor and risk gates
scope_definitions.BR_POST_MACRO_RSI: BR_PATTERN with frozen 4h macro alignment and 15m RSI hard gates passed
scope_definitions.BR_POST_FACTOR: BR_PATTERN with frozen assess_factors blocked_reason=None (macro, RSI, factor score and positive-group chain)
scope_definitions.BR_AFTER_FEE_PASS: BR_POST_FACTOR with RR after frozen round-trip fee >= 1.8
scope_definitions.BR_AFTER_SLIPPAGE_PASS: BR_POST_FACTOR with RR after fee and frozen slippage >= 1.8
scope_definitions.BR_RISK_PASS: BR_POST_FACTOR with frozen fee, slippage, funding reserve, notional and geometry plan passed
scope_definitions.BR_HISTORICAL_FILLED: frozen v0.2.2 event-driven baseline trade has entered_at_ms

expected_reference_counts.note: current frozen code is authoritative; differences from approximate historical references are reported and never forced

matched_controls.selection: deterministic nearest absolute bar distance; earlier decision close tie-break

directionality.incomplete_rule: exclude any window whose end is after development_end_exclusive

near_miss.gross_rr_near_miss: post-factor, valid geometry, gross RR <1.8; nearest gross RR below 1.8 after identity matching

trade_audit.baseline_source: immutable v0.2.2 Development run artifact, identity/hash verified

H11.statement: BR pattern candidates contain incremental directional information beyond same trend regime and volatility bucket
H11.gate: at least 100 complete 4h candidates and mean controls >=3
H11.support: 4h and 8h signed-return deltas >0; both bootstrap p05 >=-0.05 ATR; +1 ATR reach deltas >0; every leave-one-year-out 4h/8h delta >0
H11.falsify: both 4h and 8h signed-return deltas <=0, or both bootstrap p95 <=0

H12.statement: Frozen non-risk factor gates improve BR directional quality beyond raw BR pattern
H12.gate: at least 100 BR patterns and at least 30 post-factor candidates with complete 4h labels
H12.support: post-factor minus pattern signed-return delta >0 at 4h and 8h, both cluster-bootstrap p05 >=-0.05 ATR, +1 ATR reach delta nonnegative at both, and positive direction in at least four complete years
H12.falsify: post-factor minus pattern signed-return delta <=0 at both 4h and 8h, or bootstrap p95 <=0 at both

H13.statement: RR/risk gate has useful directional selection value beyond merely enlarging payoff geometry
H13.gate: at least 20 final risk-pass candidates with complete 4h labels
H13.support: risk-pass minus post-factor signed-return delta >0 at 4h and 8h with p05 >=-0.05 and positive multi-year evidence
H13.falsify_when_evaluable: at least 20 risk-pass candidates and both 4h/8h deltas <=0
